title: bndy workboard
description: Single view of active bndy product, platform, ingestion, intelligence and growth work.
principles: Canonical BNDY APIs remain the write authority.
Capture is transport and durable intake, not the intelligence engine.
Enrichment is the resolution and intelligence runtime.
All new ingestion paths should converge on Capture + Enrichment rather than inventing another write path.
The target state is evidence -> claims -> projection -> canonical BNDY, not source -> direct database write.

repositories.role: Core public gig discovery PWA: map, gigs, artists, venues, festivals, favourites and public add flows.
Authoritative artists, venues, events, festivals, auth, curator policy, source inspection and edition-aware APIs.
Admin operations, curator policy management and traffic visibility.
Public brand, proposition, policy and architecture pages. This workboard lives here.
Public Dropzone UI for gig poster and text submission. Now routes into Capture.
Durable intake transport for Android Send to bndy and public web submissions. Stores evidence and queue state.
Capture processing, Facebook/event resolution, source acquisition, identity matching and target evidence/claims/projection architecture.
Thin agent-facing adapter around BNDY capabilities. Needs a current-role audit as Enrichment becomes the orchestration layer.
Older Signal -> interpretation -> claims implementation. Chatzone has been removed from this path; useful concepts should be absorbed then the runtime retired.
Previous public application. Do not use for new work.
Shared type definitions used by older/newer surfaces where applicable.
Shared UI package from the earlier application generation. Audit before expanding usage.

repositories.repo: flowency-live/bndy.live, bndylivebeta, bndy-centrestage, bndy-portal, bndy-api, bndy-infrastructure
repositories.role: Older BNDY generations. Confirm no live dependency, then archive or label clearly to reduce agent confusion.

lanes.title: Core live discovery
lanes.objective: Make bndy.live the best way to discover grassroots live music.

done.title: bndy.live is the current public product
done.detail: Map, gig list, artist and venue profiles are on the bndy-app + canonical API stack.

done.title: Mobile gig-list UX heavily refined
done.detail: Search-first layout, compact filters, favourites and venue/mobile presentation have been iterated.

done.title: Ticketing surfaced at event and venue level
done.detail: Recent work makes ticketed status explicit without treating unknown admission as a reason to hide a gig.

now.title: Keep all public CRUD on canonical APIs
now.detail: New public add flows currently resolve data then write through the existing canonical backend.

now.title: Separate product UX from evidence architecture
now.detail: The UI can stay simple while the backend moves from direct creation to claims/projection.

next.title: Route all assisted creation through shared evidence
next.detail: Artist, venue and gig creation should emit evidence/claims before projection rather than each surface inventing its own logic.

next.title: PWA install journey
next.detail: Finish the explicit Add to Home Screen/install experience requested by users.

lanes.title: Festivals
lanes.objective: Treat festivals as first-class discovery objects with child gigs/events.

done.title: Festival lists and detail are live-capable
done.detail: Festival APIs, public views and child event handling have been added.

done.title: Publication-scope filtering added
done.detail: Festival visibility now participates in edition/publication filtering alongside artists, venues and events.

now.title: Curator festival parity
now.detail: Festival routes need the same ownership/postcode policy confidence as normal entities.

next.title: Festival ingestion through Enrichment
next.detail: Source-discovered festival data should become claims and project into canonical festivals/events.

lanes.title: Curators & Godmode
lanes.objective: Delegate local data stewardship safely without giving every curator global write access.

done.title: Postcode-area restrictions
done.detail: Curator access policies can be limited by configured postcode areas.

done.title: Ownership restrictions
done.detail: Curators can be restricted to records they created, while trusted curators can be broader.

done.title: Godmode policy editor
done.detail: Backstage now has curator permission management and creator provenance is recorded by public wizards.

now.title: Production verification
now.detail: Exercise postcode, own-only and trusted/global combinations against artists, venues, events and festivals.

next.title: Curator dashboard
next.detail: Give curators a clear view of their area, records, outstanding quality issues and recent submissions.

lanes.title: Facebook artist assist
lanes.objective: Paste a Facebook artist URL and let BNDY resolve enough trustworthy data to make creation effortless.

done.title: Facebook source inspector
done.detail: Backend now handles About data, mbasic/title fallbacks, profile wrappers and rejects Facebook login/error/system identities.

done.title: Artist form prefill
done.detail: Standalone Add Artist and Add Gig can prefill source-backed name/location/bio/website hints and persist them.

done.title: Inspector route hardened
done.detail: Recent deploy work keeps the companion source-inspector route present after normal API deployments.

now.title: Still a direct canonical creation path
now.detail: The resolver helps the UI, but accepted data is still written directly through canonical creation rather than becoming durable claims first.

next.title: Converge with Enrichment evidence model
next.detail: Reuse the same Observation/Extraction/Interpretation/Claim pipeline used by automated ingestion.

next.title: Show evidence confidence in the form
next.detail: Differentiate observed Facebook facts, inferred values and mere handle/name hints.

lanes.title: chat.bndy.live public ingestion
lanes.objective: Let anyone submit a gig poster or event text and get a useful, low-friction result.

done.title: Disconnected from bndy-signals
done.detail: The public Dropzone no longer uses the old Signals/Textract/Haiku claims UI.

done.title: Multimodal poster interpretation
done.detail: Poster processing now uses the actual image in the Capture/Enrichment path, avoiding OCR-only mistakes such as treating a T-shirt logo as an artist.

done.title: Useful result response
done.detail: Added/already-existing results now show artist, venue, date/time and a direct bndy.live gig link.

now.title: Processing latency
now.detail: Public submissions still rely on the periodic scanner before reaching SQS; this can add minutes of dead time.

next.title: Enqueue immediately on submission
next.detail: Send the Capture message to the processing queue at create time and keep the scanner only as a recovery safety net.

next.title: Richer live progress
next.detail: Show resolving artist, matching venue, deduping event and final result rather than a generic spinner.

lanes.title: Send to bndy / Capture transport
lanes.objective: One durable intake layer for Android, web, WhatsApp, Messenger and future channels.

done.title: Android share target
done.detail: Send to bndy accepts shared URLs/text/images, writes locally first and syncs to capture.bndy.co.uk.

done.title: Durable AWS backlog
done.detail: Capture API, DynamoDB and S3 provide transport-independent evidence storage and processing state.

done.title: Facebook event sharing proven
done.detail: Opaque Facebook /share URLs are resolved to exact canonical event URLs, deduped and projected safely.

done.title: Public Dropzone transport added
done.detail: chat.bndy.live now uses the same Capture intake instead of a parallel backend.

now.title: Capture is not the resolution engine
now.detail: It is the transport/backlog. bndy-enrichment performs interpretation, matching and canonical projection.

next.title: Immediate queue dispatch
next.detail: Remove the normal-path dependency on the five-minute scanner.

next.title: Transport idempotency
next.detail: Add stronger submission idempotency and lease recovery for unattended/high-volume use.

lanes.title: Intelligence, claims & inference
lanes.objective: Make sources produce evidence and claims; let policy derive BNDY truth.

done.title: Target architecture defined
done.detail: bndy-enrichment documents Observation, Extraction, Interpretation, Claim, EvidencePack, authority policy, tombstones and projection workers.

done.title: Capture interpretation runs in Enrichment
done.detail: Facebook events and posters already use the newer enrichment runtime for resolution.

done.title: Canonical APIs remain the write boundary
done.detail: Artist, venue and event uniqueness/dedupe is still enforced centrally.

now.title: Critical convergence gap
now.detail: Capture and Facebook-assisted public creation currently resolve intelligently, then call canonical creation directly. They do not yet make the full durable claims/inference layer the authoritative path.

now.title: Two generations of claims thinking exist
now.detail: bndy-signals contains the older cognitive runtime; bndy-enrichment contains the newer target architecture.

next.title: Make claims/projection the shared write path
next.detail: Capture, Add Artist, source crawlers, WhatsApp and Messenger should all emit claims into one projection pipeline.

next.title: Migrate useful Signals concepts
next.detail: Salvage source adapters, review semantics and useful ADRs from bndy-signals, then retire its runtime.

next.title: Expose intelligence operationally
next.detail: Add claim/evidence provenance and confidence views to Godmode so data decisions are inspectable.

lanes.title: Automated source acquisition
lanes.objective: Continuously discover grassroots artists, venues and gigs without manual database entry.

done.title: Source-backed architecture exists
done.detail: Source registry, browser acquisition, budgets/cache and source-specific adapters are defined in Enrichment.

done.title: Existing canonical duplicate gates proven
done.detail: Artist, venue and event APIs safely reject duplicates while returning reusable canonical identity.

now.title: Human Capture is ahead of scheduled acquisition
now.detail: Facebook event sharing and posters are production-proven; unattended source expansion is still being consolidated.

next.title: Bring scheduled sources onto the same claims path
next.detail: GigsNews and future adapters should write claims/evidence, not bypass Enrichment policy.

next.title: Broaden unattended source coverage
next.detail: Venue calendars, promoters, public Facebook evidence and trusted local source lists.

lanes.title: Meta / Facebook presence
lanes.objective: Give BNDY an official Meta identity and make Facebook a supported public intake channel without personal-account automation.

done.title: BNDY Facebook Page created
done.detail: The public Page exists and Meta developer setup has been started.

done.title: Facebook URLs work without Graph dependency
done.detail: Public source inspection and Capture can resolve useful Facebook evidence without making privileged Graph access a core dependency.

now.title: Meta app setup is not yet a finished product channel
now.detail: Page/app configuration work exists, but Messenger intake and production permissions are not yet complete.

next.title: Messenger Send to bndy
next.detail: Webhook BNDY Page messages into Capture using the same transport-neutral submission model.

next.title: Complete Meta permissions/app review
next.detail: Only request the permissions actually needed for messaging and public BNDY identity.

lanes.title: WhatsApp Send to bndy
lanes.objective: Let anybody send a poster, link or event message to BNDY like messaging a friend.

done.title: Architecture/spec decided
done.detail: WhatsApp is a transport into Capture, not another ingestion brain. Message IDs provide dedupe; media is downloaded then stored as Capture evidence.

now.title: Not built yet
now.detail: No production WhatsApp webhook/number intake has been completed.

next.title: Cloud API webhook
next.detail: Verify Meta signature, acknowledge quickly, enqueue work and map text/media into Capture.

next.title: Public BNDY number
next.detail: Configure the BNDY WhatsApp Business number and simple acknowledgement/status replies.

lanes.title: Analytics & traffic
lanes.objective: Understand usage across every BNDY surface without adding unnecessary cost or complexity.

done.title: Cloudflare Web Analytics added to bndy.live

done.title: Godmode traffic panel

next.title: One analytics coverage matrix
next.detail: Track visits, submissions, successful additions, searches, map interactions and PWA installs across all public surfaces.

now.title: Workboard
